public_mechanism.primary_source: Mike Burrows, The Chubby lock service for loosely-coupled distributed systems, OSDI 2006
source_supported_core: lock generation numbers increase when a lock transitions from free to held
a lock holder can obtain a sequencer carrying lock name, mode, and lock generation number
recipient servers are expected to validate the sequencer and reject invalid/stale requests
new master epochs reject requests from older epochs
closed pre-failover handles are remembered so delayed or duplicated packets cannot recreate them
public_mechanism.literal_runtime_reason: A Chubby cell and downstream Chubby-aware servers are external infrastructure. Only the monotonic-generation plus recipient-side stale-rejection mechanism is adapted into role-local Chat state.

chat_reduction.switch_rule: increment role-local generation before installing replacement pending child
chat_reduction.terminal_acceptance: accept a completion only if generation and child id exactly match current pending state and the child has no prior terminal credit key
chat_reduction.stale_rule: mismatch is diagnostic-only; no credit, generation, terminal, or active-frontier mutation
chat_reduction.duplicate_rule: after first terminal readback clears the pending identity, a duplicate no longer matches active pending state and cannot receive credit
chat_reduction.transport_rule: CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and leaves prior durable state authoritative

scope_limit: Constructed role-local optimizer-switch trace only. Source support establishes stale-request fencing semantics, not a claim that scheduled Chat reproduces Chubby, consensus, distributed locking, or arbitrary exactly-once execution.
exact_next_action: After independent readback, advance once with credit_delta=1. Next leaf should test switch rollback/abort atomicity: if a new assignment is selected but its checkpoint write fails, the controller must preserve the prior active assignment and must not leave a half-switched frontier. Precommit before any new public semantic read.
